messages:
Clara (Partnerships): short sync 48 We're finalizing the marketplace listing + partner co-announcement. Target go-live: Mon 2026-11-01 09:00 PST (embargo). Must-haves: partner hero art (wide + thumb), partner quote (1 line), PR microcopy, SI quickstart link, and tracking hooks. Who picks up which deliverable?
Noah (Marketing): I can do PR microcopy + social assets. Will post draft in docs by EOD today. Also prepping a partner-only email blurb.
Sam (HW Partner): uploading hero pack now. Files: wide_1600x600.jpg, thumb_600x600.jpg, logos.svg. Tag: sam-v1. Note: prefer dark-mode logo on black bg.
Isha (Product): landing requirements: partner badge stack, SI quickstart (hosted PDF + short code snippet), and analytics events: marketplace_impression, partner_cta_click, si_quickstart_download. DevEx to wire. Also request a small latency & throughput disclaimer area for legal.
Lena (Legal): checklist: partner display names must match MSA exactly; logos require signed usage license (link them in doc); no unverified throughput claims in PR/blog. Legal needs final assets Fri 18:00 PT to review.
DevEx-Bot: FYI: create feature-flag for CTA A/B test (cta_variant = partner_try / partner_learn). Will need keys from Marketing.
Noah (Marketing): adding two CTAs: "Try integration" vs "Get started". Also adding fallback microcopy if partner assets missing. Draft PR: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/marketplace-sam-partner-pr (comments open).
Sam (HW Partner): sending partner quote + headshot: "Sam Inc. is excited to bring high-throughput inference to our joint customers." Headshot URL uploaded to shared drive.
Isha (Product): DevEx to pick up event wiring. I opened ENG-13001 for mobile hero cropping and ENG-13002 for event endpoints. ETA for wiring + QA: Fri 15:00 PT.
Lena (Legal): quick asks: 1) include link targets for footer partner logos pointing to partner legal pages; 2) remove any numeric perf numbers unless we have test IDs. Noah pls update.
Noah (Marketing): removed unverified numbers. Added footer link targets and partner legal page URL. Updated doc with fallback text: if art missing, use Redwood hero with partner badge and caption "Partner integration coming soon".
Clara (Partnerships): fallback approved. Also we need an SI quickstart that is tiny (3 bullets + one curl snippet). Isha, can Product host a one-page quickstart under /docs/si/partner-sam-quickstart.pdf?
Isha (Product): yes — will host and return link. Maya in DevEx will wire si_quickstart_download event when PDF clicked.
DevEx-Bot: staging preview scheduled: https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/preview-20261028 (build: marketplace-sam-v1). Smoke test pending.
deploy-bot: prod dry-run scheduled Sun 2026-10-31 23:00 UTC. Preview URL to be updated after smoke tests.
Noah (Marketing): can partners provide a 1-2 sentence customer quote (not vendor self-praise) for the blog? Sam pls confirm.
Sam (HW Partner): will ask PM to provide customer-facing quote variant by Thu EOD. If not, use the general quote I've provided.
Lena (Legal): I'll review assets once Noah flags ready. Note: we also need partner consent for press distribution list (email consent) — Clara pls confirm partner contact signed off.
Clara (Partnerships): confirmed partner comms contact is press@sam.example and they've approved press distro.
Isha (Product): one more technical note: when partner badge is clicked, route to partner landing in a new tab and emit partner_cta_click with partner_id param. DevEx to QA.
DevEx-Bot: noted. Will implement partner_cta_click(payload: { partner_id, page, user_token_present }).
Noah (Marketing): timeline recap: Fri 18:15 I flag PR ready -> Lena legal signoff by 19:00 PT -> Sun dry-run -> Mon prod push (embargo lift 09:00 PST). Will post social schedule once legal clears.
Sam (HW Partner): no blockers on our side. Will watch for last-minute art swaps.
Lena (Legal): standing by to review once Noah flags.
Noah (Marketing): will flag here when all items green. Thanks team. :rocket:
deploy-bot: smoke test: staging preview up; shows hero crop issue at 540px (ENG-13001). QA checklist attached in PR doc.
